items.title: 2 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: A short camel-supported introduction to the dunes
highlights: Sunset and sunrise in the dunes
items.overview: A gentle two-day camel trek from M'Hamid into the southern Moroccan Sahara. Travel at the pace of a nomadic caravan, enjoy freshly prepared Moroccan food, and sleep beneath the desert sky.

itinerary.title: M'Hamid to the dunes
itinerary.description: Meet the camel team in M'Hamid and set out across the first dunes. Settle into a traditional camp for dinner, tea, and stargazing.

itinerary.title: Desert sunrise and return
itinerary.description: Watch sunrise over the sand, enjoy breakfast, and make the unhurried return to M'Hamid.

items.title: 3 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: Three days of walking and camping with a camel caravan
items.overview: An accessible three-day Sahara trek designed around quiet walking, nomadic hospitality, and two nights camping in the open desert.

itinerary.title: M'Hamid to Sidi Naji
itinerary.description: Cross the palm groves and walk toward the old pilgrimage area of Sidi Naji before camping in the desert.

itinerary.title: Sidi Naji to Erg Aït Ounir
itinerary.description: Follow the caravan through sand and open plains to a new camp among the dunes.

itinerary.title: Return to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Breakfast in camp and a final walk back toward M'Hamid.

items.title: 4 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: A longer nomadic trek through southern Morocco's dunes
items.overview: Spend four days moving through the Sahara with a local camel team. The route is built for travelers who want more time away from roads and crowds.

itinerary.title: Meet the caravan
itinerary.description: Begin from M'Hamid and head into the first dune fields.

itinerary.title: Desert rhythms
itinerary.description: Walk at a relaxed pace with stops for tea and lunch in the shade.

itinerary.title: Deep desert camp
itinerary.description: Explore remote sand and camp with a traditional dinner.

itinerary.title: Return to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final sunrise before returning to the village.

items.title: 5 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: Five days of camel trekking and nomadic camp life
items.overview: A five-day expedition for travelers seeking a slower, deeper Sahara experience, with camel support and camping far from the usual routes.

itinerary.title: Departure from M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Meet the team and start across the desert edge.

itinerary.title: Dunes and desert plains
itinerary.description: Continue through varied desert terrain.

itinerary.title: Nomadic camp life
itinerary.description: A full day of trekking, tea, and camp cooking.

itinerary.title: Remote Sahara
itinerary.description: Explore quiet dune country at the rhythm of the caravan.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.description: Breakfast and return to M'Hamid.

items.title: 6 Days Camel Trek Zagora Sahara Desert Nomadic Adventure
items.subtitle: A six-day Sahara caravan through dunes, oases, and hammada
items.overview: A six-day nomadic adventure from the Zagora region, combining walking or camel riding with traditional desert camps and local Sahrawi hospitality.

itinerary.title: Zagora to the desert gateway
itinerary.description: Transfer toward M'Hamid and meet the caravan.

itinerary.title: Into the dunes
itinerary.description: Trek through the first dune fields and camp.

itinerary.title: Oases and hammada
itinerary.description: Cross varied desert landscapes with the camel team.

itinerary.title: Nomadic Sahara
itinerary.description: Continue through remote country and camp under the stars.

itinerary.title: Final desert stage
itinerary.description: A last full day with the caravan.

itinerary.title: Return to Zagora
itinerary.description: Trek back toward M'Hamid and transfer to Zagora.

items.title: 7 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: A week-long camel-supported journey into the Great Sahara
items.overview: A complete week in the southern Moroccan Sahara, traveling with nomadic guides, camel handlers, and a mobile camp.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Travel south through the Atlas and Drâa Valley to meet the desert team.

itinerary.title: M'Hamid to Sidi Naji
itinerary.description: Begin the trek through alternating sand and rocky plains.

itinerary.title: Caravan route
itinerary.description: Continue through quiet desert landscapes.

itinerary.title: Deep Sahara
itinerary.description: A full day of walking and camp life.

itinerary.title: Dune country
itinerary.description: Follow the nomadic route between camps.

itinerary.title: Final camp
itinerary.description: Enjoy the last evening around the fire.

itinerary.title: Return journey
itinerary.description: Complete the trek and arrange onward travel.

items.title: 8 Days Sahara Desert Trekking Morocco
items.subtitle: An eight-day immersion in the Moroccan Sahara
items.overview: An extended camel trek for travelers who want to fully disconnect and discover the Sahara at a nomadic pace.

itinerary.title: Arrival and caravan briefing
itinerary.description: Travel to the desert gateway and meet the team.

itinerary.title: First trekking stage
itinerary.description: Set out through dunes and open plains.

itinerary.title: Desert route
itinerary.description: Walk alongside the camels and camp in the wild.

itinerary.title: Nomadic landscapes
itinerary.description: Continue through remote Sahara terrain.

itinerary.title: Camp life
itinerary.description: Trek, rest, and share a freshly prepared meal.

itinerary.title: Dunes and stars
itinerary.description: A further stage into quiet dune country.

itinerary.title: Last desert night
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final campfire evening.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.description: Finish the trek and return to M'Hamid.

items.title: 3 Days Sahara Desert Tour from M'Hamid to Erg Chigaga
items.subtitle: A 4x4 journey from Morocco's desert gateway to its wildest dunes
items.overview: Travel by 4x4 from M'Hamid to remote Erg Chigaga, passing golden dunes, rocky reg, and wide hamada landscapes beyond the paved road.

itinerary.title: M'Hamid to desert camp
itinerary.description: Leave the village by 4x4 and cross changing desert terrain to camp.

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description: Explore the large dune field and enjoy sunset in the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Return to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Watch sunrise and travel back across the desert.

items.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Erg Chigaga
items.subtitle: Atlas passes, kasbahs, the Drâa Valley, and wild Sahara dunes
items.overview: A four-day private-style circuit from Marrakech into Erg Chigaga, combining the High Atlas, historic kasbahs, palm valleys, and a desert camp experience.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Aït Ben Haddou
itinerary.description: Cross the High Atlas, visit Telouet and Aït Ben Haddou, and continue south.

itinerary.title: Drâa Valley to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Travel through Agdz, Zagora, and the palm-lined Drâa Valley.

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description: Cross the desert to the dunes for camel riding, sandboarding, dinner, and music at camp.

itinerary.title: Erg Chigaga to Marrakech
itinerary.description: Return via Lake Iriki, Foum Zguid, Taznakht, and the Atlas.

items.title: 3 Day Sahara Desert Tour from Ouarzazate to Erg Chigaga
items.subtitle: A short 4x4 escape through the Drâa Valley to remote dunes
items.overview: A compact journey from Ouarzazate through Agdz, Zagora, the Drâa Valley, and M'Hamid to the vast Erg Chigaga dune field.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to M'Hamid
itinerary.description: Drive through Agdz, Zagora, and palm-lined Drâa Valley landscapes.

itinerary.title: M'Hamid to Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description: Travel by 4x4 to the dunes for a camel ride and desert-camp night.

itinerary.title: Return to Ouarzazate
itinerary.description: Watch sunrise and return through the south's varied landscapes.

items.title: Chegaga Desert Tour from Ouarzazate 2 Days
items.subtitle: A fast route from Ouarzazate to an overnight in Erg Chigaga
items.overview: A quick desert getaway from Ouarzazate, combining a 4x4 crossing, the Zagora oasis, a Berber camp, and sunrise over Erg Chigaga.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Erg Chigaga
itinerary.description: Drive through southern Morocco to the dunes, then enjoy dinner and music at camp.

itinerary.title: Sunrise and return
itinerary.description: Climb a dune at sunrise, have breakfast, and return to Ouarzazate.

items.title: 5-Day Desert Tour Agadir to Erg Chegaga Dunes Round Trip
items.subtitle: An Agadir return journey across kasbahs, mountains, and wild Sahara
items.overview: A five-day round trip from Agadir to the remote Erg Chegaga dunes, moving through Berber towns, kasbahs, mountain roads, and the open Sahara.

itinerary.title: Agadir to southern Morocco
itinerary.description: Travel through the Souss region and south toward the desert.

itinerary.title: Kasbahs and valleys
itinerary.description: Explore historic settlements and palm-filled landscapes.

itinerary.title: Erg Chegaga
itinerary.description: Reach the dunes for camel riding, sandboarding, and a camp night.

itinerary.title: Iriki National Park
itinerary.description: Cross the remote desert and lake landscapes by 4x4.

itinerary.title: Return to Agadir
itinerary.description: Complete the circuit through southern Morocco.
